items.source:
Get all bean names for the given type, including those defined in ancestor
factories.
items.translation: 获取给定类型的所有 Bean 名称，包括在祖先工厂中定义的那些。

items.source: Create a new AotServices.Loader that will obtain AOT services from "META-INF/spring/aot.factories"<T> as well as the given ListableBeanFactory.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 AotServices.Loader，该加载器将从 "META-INF/spring/aot.factories"<T> 以及给定的 ListableBeanFactory 中获取 AOT 服务。

items.source: Create a new AotServices.Loader that will obtain AOT services from the given SpringFactoriesLoader and ListableBeanFactory.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AotServices.Loader，该加载器将从给定的SpringFactoriesLoader和ListableBeanFactory获取 AOT 服务。

items.source: Find beans annotated with @ControllerAdvice in the given ListableBeanFactory and wrap them as ControllerAdviceBean instances.
items.translation: 在指定的ListableBeanFactory中查找带有@ControllerAdvice注解的 Bean，并将它们包装为ControllerAdviceBean实例。

items.source: Callback interface for initializing a Spring ListableBeanFactory prior to entering the singleton pre-instantiation phase.
items.translation: 用于在单例预实例化阶段之前初始化 Spring ListableBeanFactory 的回调接口。

items.source: Create a new BeanFactoryAspectJAdvisorsBuilder for the given BeanFactory.
items.translation: 为给定的 BeanFactory 创建一个新的 BeanFactoryAspectJAdvisorsBuilder。

items.source:
Return a single bean of the given type or subtypes, not looking in ancestor
factories.
items.translation: 返回给定类型或其子类型的单个 Bean，不查看祖先工厂。

items.source:
Return a single bean of the given type or subtypes, also picking up beans
defined in ancestor bean factories if the current bean factory is a
HierarchicalBeanFactory.
items.translation: 返回给定类型或其子类型的单个 Bean，如果当前 Bean 工厂是 HierarchicalBeanFactory，还会获取在祖先 Bean 工厂中定义的 Bean。

items.source:
Return all beans of the given type or subtypes, also picking up beans defined in
ancestor bean factories if the current bean factory is a HierarchicalBeanFactory.
items.translation: 返回给定类型或其子类型的所有 Bean，如果当前 Bean 工厂是 `HierarchicalBeanFactory`，还会获取在祖先 Bean 工厂中定义的 Bean。

items.source: WebApplicationContext implementation which accepts component classes as input — in particular @Configuration classes, but also plain @Component classes as well as JSR-330 compliant classes using jakarta.inject annotations.
items.translation: 实现接受组件类作为输入的WebApplicationContext——特别是@Configuration类，但也包括普通的@Component类以及使用jakarta.inject注解的符合 JSR-330 规范的类。

items.source: An ApplicationContext implementation that extends GenericApplicationContext and implements GroovyObject such that beans can be retrieved with the dot de-reference syntax instead of using AbstractApplicationContext.getBean(String).
items.translation: 一个实现 `ApplicationContext` 并扩展 GenericApplicationContext 且实现 `GroovyObject` 的类，使得可以通过点解引用语法获取 Bean，而无需使用 AbstractApplicationContext.getBean(String)。

items.source: Standalone application context, accepting component classes as input — in particular @Configuration-annotated classes, but also plain @Component types and JSR-330 compliant classes using jakarta.inject annotations.
items.translation: 独立应用程序上下文，接受组件类作为输入——特别是带有@Configuration注解的类，以及普通的@Component类型和符合 JSR-330 规范并使用`jakarta.inject`注解的类。

items.source: Retrieve all beans of type T from the given BeanFactory declaring a qualifier (for example, via <qualifier> or @Qualifier) matching the given qualifier, or having a bean name matching the given qualifier.
items.translation: 从给定的 BeanFactory 检索所有类型为 T 且声明了与给定限定符匹配的限定符（例如，通过 <qualifier> 或 @Qualifier）的 Bean，或者具有与给定限定符匹配的 Bean 名称的 Bean。

items.source: Spring's default implementation of the ConfigurableListableBeanFactory and BeanDefinitionRegistry interfaces: a full-fledged bean factory based on bean definition metadata, extensible through post-processors.
items.translation: Spring 对 ConfigurableListableBeanFactory和BeanDefinitionRegistry接口的默认实现：一个基于 bean 定义元数据的完整功能 bean 工厂，可通过后置处理器进行扩展。

items.source: Base class for ApplicationContext implementations which are supposed to support multiple calls to AbstractApplicationContext.refresh(), creating a new internal bean factory instance every time.
items.translation: 支持多次调用AbstractApplicationContext.refresh()的ApplicationContext实现类的基类，每次调用都会创建一个新的内部 BeanFactory 实例。

items.source: Convenient base class for ApplicationContext implementations, drawing configuration from XML documents containing bean definitions understood by an XmlBeanDefinitionReader.
items.translation: 适用于 `ApplicationContext` 实现的便捷基类，其配置从包含由 `XmlBeanDefinitionReader` 理解的 bean 定义的 XML 文档中读取。

items.source: BeanFactoryInitializer that eagerly initializes DynamicPropertyRegistrar beans.
items.translation: BeanFactoryInitializer 会急切初始化 DynamicPropertyRegistrar 的 Bean。

items.source: AbstractRefreshableApplicationContext subclass which implements the ConfigurableWebApplicationContext interface for web environments.
items.translation: 实现`ConfigurableWebApplicationContext`接口的`AbstractRefreshableApplicationContext`子类，用于 Web 环境。

items.source: WebApplicationContext implementation which takes its configuration from Groovy bean definition scripts and/or XML files, as understood by a GroovyBeanDefinitionReader.
items.translation: 一个 `WebApplicationContext` 实现，它从 Groovy bean 定义脚本和/或 XML 文件获取配置，这些文件由 GroovyBeanDefinitionReader 理解。

items.source: WebApplicationContext implementation which takes its configuration from XML documents, understood by an XmlBeanDefinitionReader.
items.translation: `WebApplicationContext` 实现，其配置从 XML 文档中获取，由 `XmlBeanDefinitionReader` 解析。

items.source: Get all bean names whose Class has the supplied Annotation type, including those defined in ancestor factories, without creating any bean instances yet.
items.translation: 获取所有其 Class 具有提供的 Annotation 类型的 bean 名称，包括在祖先工厂中定义的 bean，且尚未创建任何 bean 实例。

items.source: Static BeanFactory implementation which allows one to register existing singleton instances programmatically.
items.translation: 支持通过编程方式注册现有单例实例的静态BeanFactory实现。

items.source: Abstract implementation of the ApplicationContext interface.
items.translation: ApplicationContext 接口的抽象实现。

items.source: AbstractRefreshableApplicationContext subclass that adds common handling of specified config locations.
items.translation: 继承自AbstractRefreshableApplicationContext的子类，用于添加对指定配置位置的通用处理。

items.source: Generic ApplicationContext implementation that holds a single internal DefaultListableBeanFactory instance and does not assume a specific bean definition format.
items.translation: 支持单个内部 DefaultListableBeanFactory 实例的通用 ApplicationContext 实现，且不假设特定的 Bean 定义格式。

items.source: ApplicationContext implementation which supports programmatic registration of beans and messages, rather than reading bean definitions from external configuration sources.
items.translation: 支持程序化注册 Bean 和消息的`ApplicationContext`实现，而不是从外部配置源读取 Bean 定义。

items.source: Subclass of GenericApplicationContext, suitable for web environments.
items.translation: `GenericApplicationContext` 的子类，适用于 Web 环境。

items.source: Static WebApplicationContext implementation for testing.
items.translation: 用于测试的静态 `WebApplicationContext` 实现。

items.source: Classes supporting the org.springframework.beans.factory package.
items.translation: 支持org.springframework.beans.factory包的类。

items.source: Support classes for the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: 支持Spring TestContext Framework的类。

items.source: Classes supporting the org.springframework.web.context package, such as WebApplicationContext implementations and various utility classes.
items.translation: 支持org.springframework.web.context包的类，例如 WebApplicationContext 实现和各种实用工具类。

items.source: Common infrastructure for handler method processing, as used by Spring MVC's org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method package.
items.translation: 用于 Spring MVC 的 `org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method` 包处理处理器方法的通用基础设施。

items.source: Classes enabling AspectJ 5 @Annotated classes to be used in Spring AOP.
items.translation: 使 AspectJ 5 @Annotated 类能够在 Spring AOP 中使用的类。

items.source: The core package implementing Spring's lightweight Inversion of Control (IoC) container.
items.translation: 实现 Spring 轻量级控制反转（IoC）容器的核心包。

items.source: Support package for annotation-driven bean configuration.
items.translation: 用于注解驱动的 Bean 配置的辅助包。

items.source: AOT support for bean factories.
items.translation: 支持 AOT 的 BeanFactory。

items.source: SPI interfaces and configuration-related convenience classes for bean factories.
items.translation: 用于 Bean 工厂的 SPI 接口和与配置相关的便捷类。

items.source:
This package builds on the beans package to add support for
message sources and for the Observer design pattern, and the
ability for application objects to obtain resources using a
consistent API.
items.translation: 该包在 beans 包的基础上增加了消息源和观察者设计模式的支持，并允许应用程序对象通过一致的 API 获取资源。

items.source:
Annotation support for the Application Context, including JSR-250 "common"
annotations, component-scanning, and Java-based metadata for creating
Spring-managed objects.
items.translation: 支持应用上下文的注解，包括 JSR-250“通用”注解、组件扫描以及用于创建 Spring 托管对象的基于 Java 的元数据。

items.source:
Classes supporting the org.springframework.context package,
such as abstract base classes for ApplicationContext
implementations and a MessageSource implementation.
items.translation: 支持 `org.springframework.context` 包的类，例如 `ApplicationContext` 实现的抽象基类和 `MessageSource` 实现。

items.source:
Support classes for DAO implementations,
providing miscellaneous utility methods.
items.translation: 支持 DAO 实现的类，提供杂项实用方法。

items.source:
This package provides declarative creation and registration of
Spring-managed beans as JMX MBeans.
items.translation: 该包提供对 Spring 管理的 Bean 作为 JMX MBean 进行声明式创建和注册。

items.source: Package providing integration of JPA (Java Persistence API) with Spring concepts.
items.translation: 提供将 JPA（Java 持久化 API）与 Spring 概念集成的包。

items.source:
Contains a variant of the application context interface for web applications,
and the ContextLoaderListener that bootstraps a root web application context.
items.translation: 包含用于 Web 应用程序的应用程序上下文接口的变体，以及引导根 Web 应用程序上下文的 ContextLoaderListener。

items.source:
Support classes for integrating a JSF web layer with a Spring service layer
which is hosted in a Spring root WebApplicationContext.
items.translation: 支持将 JSF 网络层与托管在 Spring 根 WebApplicationContext 中的 Spring 服务层集成的支持类。

items.source: Return all bean names in the factory, including ancestor factories.
items.translation: 返回工厂中的所有 Bean 名称，包括祖先工厂中的 Bean。

items.source: Count all beans in any hierarchy in which this factory participates.
items.translation: 统计该工厂参与的任意层次结构中的所有 Bean。

items.source: Configuration interface to be implemented by most listable bean factories.
items.translation: 大多数可列出 Bean 工厂需要实现的配置接口。

items.source: Central interface to provide configuration for an application.
items.translation: 提供应用程序配置的中央接口。

items.source: SPI interface to be implemented by most if not all application contexts.
items.translation: 由大多数甚至所有应用程序上下文实现的 SPI 接口。

items.source:
Standalone XML application context, taking the context definition files
from the class path, interpreting plain paths as class path resource names
that include the package path (for example, "mypackage/myresource.txt").
items.translation: 独立 XML 应用程序上下文，从类路径中获取上下文定义文件，将普通路径解释为包含包路径的类路径资源名称（例如，"mypackage/myresource.txt"）。

items.source:
Standalone XML application context, taking the context definition files
from the file system or from URLs, interpreting plain paths as relative
file system locations (for example, "mydir/myfile.txt").
items.translation: 独立 XML 应用程序上下文，从文件系统或 URL 获取上下文定义文件，将纯路径解释为相对文件系统位置（例如"mydir/myfile.txt"）。

items.source: Convenient application context with built-in XML support.
items.translation: 带有内置 XML 支持的不便应用程序上下文。

items.source: Detect all PersistenceExceptionTranslators in the given BeanFactory.
items.translation: 在指定的 BeanFactory 中检测所有 PersistenceExceptionTranslators。

items.source:
Create a new PersistenceExceptionTranslationInterceptor, autodetecting
PersistenceExceptionTranslators in the given BeanFactory.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 PersistenceExceptionTranslationInterceptor，在指定的 BeanFactory 中自动检测 PersistenceExceptionTranslators。

items.source: Return whether the specified bean definition should be considered as lazy-init.
items.translation: 返回指定的 Bean 定义是否应被视为懒加载。

items.source:
Find an EntityManagerFactory with the given name in the given
Spring application context (represented as ListableBeanFactory).
items.translation: 在给定的 Spring 应用程序上下文（表示为 ListableBeanFactory）中查找具有给定名称的 EntityManagerFactory。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by configurable web application contexts.
items.translation: 由可配置 Web 应用程序上下文实现的接口。

items.source: Interface to provide configuration for a web application.
items.translation: 用于为 Web 应用程序提供配置的接口。

items.source: Retrieve the Spring BeanFactory to delegate bean name resolution to.
items.translation: 获取用于委派 Bean 名称解析的 Spring BeanFactory。
